author: Notar
name: Notar
description:
Class: couch cookie. Like a couch potato except cookie.

Attribute: horizontal

Description: 
“Often found lying on the floor surrounded by cookies and some method to watch streams of Ninomae Ina’nis of Hololive English. Although called a ‘couch’ cookie, they are more often found lying on a floor. This misnomer comes from the first few sightings of them on couches, but we now know the couch cookie will sleep on many surfaces, beds, floors, sometimes tables. 

This species of takodachi has been spotted consuming massive amounts of cookies while not moving from its place of rest. Despite this, the couch cookie does not gain mass, this is likely due to the connection with the void. 

It is a rare occurrence to witness the couch cookie move from its position, and only a few documented cases have been recorded. This is usually done to either change its sleeping point to a cooler area or to restock its cookie pile, at which point, the couch cookie will lie down once more and settle to watch streams of Ninomae Ina’nis from Hololive English.

However, in secret, even fewer sightings are seen of the couch cookie spreading awareness of their priestess through comments and posts on other sites, furthering the silent movement of WAHrld domINAtion as all takodachis do”

author: Husker
name: Husker
description:
Class / Category: Quiet Tide Tako
Attributes: Patient / Steadfast

Description:
"Content to drift in the calmer currents, this Tako watches from the shadows of the reef, its presence felt more than seen. Though rarely at the forefront, it remains ever loyal to the Priestess, offering silent support through every voyage. When the tides of celebration come, it surfaces with a gentle wave, reminding all that the deep still holds many faithful hearts."

author: Scalim
name: Scalim
description:
Class: Mage
Attributes: Optimistic / Squishy
This Optimistic Mage serves with a boundless sense of cheer, casting spells that shimmer with positivity and light. Despite their incredibly Squishy form, which isn't built for direct combat, their resilience is unmatched; they always bounce back with a smile. Their magic is often a shield of support and comfort, proving that true power comes not from brute force, but from an unwavering, hopeful heart.

author: Kaede, Acolyte of Wahtcher
name: Kaede Nakamura
description:
Category: Priestess
Attributes: Devout/Warm

"A Priestess from a parallel world, this humanoids Tako resides in a shrine dedicated to Wahtcher. There were more of her kind in her world, but they have fled to the void between worlds during a war. She has striking similarities to the priestess of AO, Ninomae Ina'nis. Kaede's main ability is spiritual healing, but has been known to have the ability to hop between dimensions, exorcise demons, and make use of her third eye. She prefers to stay hidden from the world, as her kind has had conflict with humans in the past.
